english: [TAB]The majority of people in all civilizations throughout time have been workers. Over time, the endless activity of workers has reshaped the very surface of the land by mining hills, cutting down huge stretches of forest, and irrigating hostile terrain into fertile farmland. english: The Janissaries were an elite fighting force of infantry raised by the Ottoman sultans. They formed the sultan's household troops and bodyguard, eventually rising to a position of enormous influence before being disbanded in the nineteenth century. Murad I founded the Janissary corps around 1330; the troops were made up of non-Muslim boys who were captured in battle or bought as slaves and brought up as warriors. This was very similar to the Mameluk slave soldiers of Egypt, who may have been the inspiration for the Janissaries. Janissaries became the first infantry units in the Ottoman military forces, because at the time no free man would consent to fighting on foot. [PARAGRAPH:2]After 1380 the system for recruiting new soldiers into the Janissaries became standardized through a process called the "devshirmeh:" this was basically a "human tax" where each community had to contribute a certain number of young boys to the state. In practice these were almost always Christian slaves. [PARAGRAPH:2]The boys were sequestered in special barracks, where they would be converted to Islam and trained to become elite soldiers (a process very similar to that practiced by the Spartans of ancient Greece). Although slaves, the Janissaries received special privileges, including the right to bear weapons and higher pay than other soldiers. Although the Janissaries began their existence as a small bodyguard for the sultan, in time they came to comprise much of the Ottoman army, topping out at over 200,000 men at some points. [PARAGRAPH:2]The Janissaries originally were trained to be expert archers, but once firearms were invented they quickly adopted the new weapons, becoming fiercely proficient with muskets. They usually used axes or sabres for melee combat. Janissaries were present at all of the major battles in the early history of the Ottoman Empire, including the Siege of Constantinople in 1453. [PARAGRAPH:2]The very success of the Janissaries would eventually destroy them. Realizing their importance, they began demanding higher pay, threatening rebellion if their demands were refused. Their first rebellion took place in 1449, and it was followed by many more. By the eighteenth century, the Janissaries dominated the government. Through frequent palace coups they changed sultans as they wished, and they blocked much-needed modernization reforms in the Ottoman army. Many of the Janissaries became corrupted, no longer training for battle but instead pursuing commercial ventures or political office, and the weakness of the Ottomans in the face of Russian and Austrian expansion soon became obvious to all. Desperate to regain control of their country, the Ottoman rulers made determined efforts to eradicate them. [PARAGRAPH:2]Finally, in 1826 Mahmud II was able to form a non-Janissary army strong enough to challenge the Janissaries. The Janissaries did not go down peacefully, and Mahmud II had to use artillery to shell the Janissaries' barracks and batter them into submission. This event - known as the "Auspicious Incident," ended the Janissaries. Their characteristic marching music is the only trace of them that remains today. [PARAGRAPH:2]
chinese: 近卫军是奥斯曼苏丹们组建的一支精锐步兵战斗力量。他们构成了苏丹的禁卫军与贴身护卫，最终崛起至拥有巨大影响力的地位，直到 19 世纪被解散。穆拉德一世约在 1330 年创立了近卫军团；士兵由在战斗中俘获或作为奴隶买来、并被培养成战士的非穆斯林男童组成。这与埃及的马穆鲁克奴隶士兵十分相似，后者很可能正是近卫军的灵感来源。近卫军成为奥斯曼军队中最早的步兵单位，因为当时没有一个自由人愿意屈尊徒步作战。[PARAGRAPH:2]1380 年之后，招募新兵进入近卫军的制度通过一项名为“德夫希尔梅”的程序而标准化：这本质上是一种“人头税”，每个社区都必须向国家贡献一定数量的男童。实际上这些几乎总是基督徒奴隶。[PARAGRAPH:2]男童被隔离在特殊营房中，在那里皈依伊斯兰教，并被训练成精锐士兵（这一过程与古希腊斯巴达人的做法十分相似）。尽管身为奴隶，近卫军却享有特殊待遇，包括携带武器的权利以及高于其他士兵的薪酬。近卫军起初不过是苏丹的一支小型护卫队，但久而久之，他们逐渐构成了奥斯曼军队的大部分，在某些时期人数超过 20 万。[PARAGRAPH:2]近卫军最初被训练成神射手，但火器一经发明，他们便迅速采用了这种新武器，成为使用滑膛枪的凶悍好手。近战时他们通常使用斧或军刀。在奥斯曼帝国早期历史上所有重大战役中都有近卫军的身影，包括 1453 年的君士坦丁堡之围。[PARAGRAPH:2]近卫军的成功最终反而毁灭了他们。意识到自身的重要性后，他们开始要求更高的薪酬，若要求被拒便以叛乱相威胁。他们的第一次叛乱发生在 1449 年，此后叛乱层出不穷。到 18 世纪，近卫军已把持了政府。他们通过频繁的宫廷政变随心所欲地更换苏丹，并阻挠奥斯曼军队亟需的现代化改革。许多近卫军日益腐化，不再为作战而训练，转而追逐商业营生或政治官职，奥斯曼在俄国与奥地利扩张面前的孱弱很快便众所周知。为夺回对国家的控制，奥斯曼统治者们下定决心要铲除他们。[PARAGRAPH:2]终于，1826 年马哈茂德二世得以组建一支足以挑战近卫军的非近卫军军队。近卫军并未束手就擒，马哈茂德二世不得不动用火炮轰击近卫军营房，将他们打得屈服。这一事件——史称“吉兆事件”——终结了近卫军。他们那标志性的进行曲，是他们如今留存于世的唯一痕迹。[PARAGRAPH:2]

english: [H1]Religion[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Religion has always played a critical part in human history. Through religion, man has sought to make sense of the universe around him and to determine his place in it. Religion has inspired, enlightened and ennobled man; in its name men have erected beautiful buildings, written books of great wisdom, and made music of surpassing beauty. In its name men have also murdered and enslaved their fellows.[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]Religion in this Game[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]We know that people have extremely strong opinions about religions - in fact, many a war has arisen when these beliefs collide. We at Firaxis have no desire to offend anyone. However, given the importance that religions have had in human development, we didn't want to simply leave them out of the game altogether; instead we have tried to handle them in as respectful, fair and even-handed manner as possible. In fact, all religions in the game have the same effects, the only difference being their requirements.[PARAGRAPH:2]There are seven religions in Civilization IV (testing having determined that seven was the optimal number for gameplay). When determining which seven to include, we picked those religions that we thought would be most familiar to our audience. We do not mean to imply that these religions are more important, better or worse than any other religions.[PARAGRAPH:2]We offer no value judgments on religion; we mean no disrespect to anyone's beliefs. We're game designers, not theologians.[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]Founding a Religion[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]If you are the first civilization to discover the associated technology, the religion is founded in one of your cities. It is extremely useful to have a city where a religion has been founded; it allows a prophet to create a "shrine" in that city (see below).[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]State Religions[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]When any cities in your civilization possess one or more religions, you may choose to assign one as the "state" religion. Having a state religion tends to make your cities possessing that religion happier and more productive; it also increases the effects of many religious buildings and religious civics.[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]Spreading Religions[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]Religions spread randomly from city to city. Religions tend to spread from a city possessing the religion to nearby cities as well as to cities the possessing city has trade routes with. Some religious buildings (see below) increase the speed at which a religion will spread, and a civilization's religious civic (see below) can have a great effect upon the spread of religions, as well. [LINK=UNIT_BUDDHIST_MISSIONARY]Missionaries[\\LINK] allow you to control the spread of religion; see the following section.[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]Missionaries[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]Civilizations can construct special "missionary" units to spread the civilization's state religion. Each civilization may have only a limited number of missionary units in play at any one time, and each costs two gold per turn to maintain.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Building Missionaries[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2] Civilizations using the [LINK=CIVIC_ORGANIZED_RELIGION]Organized Religion[\\LINK] civic can construct missionaries in any city with the state religion; if a civilization is not following Organized Religion, it can build missionaries only in cities with Monasteries.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Moving Missionaries[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]Once constructed, missionaries can move about the map like any other unit. Your missionaries can freely enter your territory or neutral territory; they cannot enter another civilization's territory until you have an [LINK=CONCEPT_DIPLOMACY]Open Borders[\\LINK] agreement with that civ. [PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]How Missionaries Spread Religion[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]When the missionary is in the target city, click on the "spread religion" order in the missionary's unit box (see [LINK=CONCEPT_UNITS]Units[\\LINK]); if the attempt is successful the missionary's religion is now in the target city. Religions spread more easily into other cities within the missionary's civilization. Further, it is easier to spread a religion into a city with few or no religions already present; each resident religion decreases the odds of success. There is no limit to how many religions may be present in a single city; all seven religions can coexist in the same city. The missionary is consumed in the conversion attempt, successful or not.[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]Benefits of Religion[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]City Benefits[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]All cities that possess your state religion receive one extra happy face and produce one culture per turn. Spreading your state religion is thus a good way to expand cultural borders in the early stages of your civilization. The holy city for your state religion also receives an additional bonus of five culture per turn, allowing it to expand its borders very quickly.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Buildings[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]Without a religion in a city, that city cannot construct religious buildings like Temples and Cathedrals (see below). Cities without religions also cannot create Priest [LINK=CONCEPT_SPECIALISTS]Specialists[\\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Shrine Income[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]If you control the holy city for a religion and generate a Great Prophet, you can build the Shrine for that religion to generate income for every city in the world that possesses your religion (see below).[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]Religious Civics[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]The religious [LINK=CONCEPT_CIVICS]Civics[\\LINK] describe how religion affects your civilization. There are five religious civics in the game. You begin the game knowing only paganism; the other four become available when you learn their associated technologies.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Paganism:[\\BOLD] No technology requirement. The basic religious civic. [PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Organized Religion:[\\BOLD] Requires [LINK=TECH_MONOTHEISM]Monotheism[\\LINK]. Increases production of buildings in cities with the state religion, and allows you to build missionaries without first constructing monasteries.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Theocracy:[\\BOLD] Requires [LINK=TECH_THEOLOGY]Theology[\\LINK]. Theocracy grants two additional experience points to units trained within cities with the state religion, and it stops the spread of non-state religions within the civilization.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Pacifism:[\\BOLD] Requires [LINK=TECH_PHILOSOPHY]Philosophy[\\LINK]. Greatly increases the [LINK=CONCEPT_GREAT_PEOPLE]Great Person[\\LINK] birth rate in cities with the state religion, and it increases the support cost of military units.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Free Religion:[\\BOLD] Requires [LINK=TECH_LIBERALISM]Liberalism[\\LINK]. A civilization with Free Religion has no state religion. Each city gets happiness for each non-state religion in the city; also, all cities get a 10%% boost in scientific [LINK=CONCEPT_RESEARCH]Research[\\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]Religious Buildings[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]There are a number of religious buildings available to be constructed. Religious buildings are dedicated to specific religions and can only be built in cities which have that religion. A city with more than one religion can have religious buildings for each religion: for example, a city with Judaism and Confucianism could construct both a Jewish Temple and a Confucian Temple.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Temples[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]The most primitive religious building. Temples boost a city's [LINK=CONCEPT_CULTURE]Culture[\\LINK] and [LINK=CONCEPT_HAPPINESS]Happiness[\\LINK]. They allow 1 population point to be turned into a priest [LINK=CONCEPT_SPECIALISTS]Specialist[\\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Monasteries[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]Monasteries increase a city's research by a small amount. More importantly, they allow the city to build missionaries to spread your religion.[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Cathedrals[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]Cathedrals drastically increase a city's culture. They increase happiness if their religion is the civilization's state religion. They allow two population points to be turned into priests. Note that "Cathedral" is a generic name for a religion's grander houses of worship - Jewish synagogues, Islamic mosques, Christian cathedrals, etc., all have the same effects. Your civilization can only build one cathedral for every three temples that your civilization possesses; for example, a civilization with seven temples could build two cathedrals. [PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Shrines[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]Shrines can be built only in cities in which a religion has been founded. Shrines are constructed by [LINK=CONCEPT_GREAT_PEOPLE]Great Prophets[\\LINK]; a great prophet is the only unit that can build a shrine, and the prophet is consumed in the process. Shrines increase the spread of the religion, as well as the home city's culture. They increase the city's chance of generating prophets and allow the city to assign three population as priests. Most importantly, shrines generate one gold each turn for every city on the map that has the shrine's religion (thus explaining the importance of creating missionaries to spread the word). Each religion has a different name for its cathedral and shrine.
chinese: [H1]宗教[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]宗教在人类历史上始终扮演着至关重要的角色。人类借助宗教，试图理解周遭的宇宙，并确定自身在其中的位置。宗教曾启迪、开化并升华了人类；以宗教之名，人们建起了美丽的建筑，写下了充满智慧的典籍，谱出了美妙绝伦的乐章。同样以宗教之名，人们也曾残杀并奴役自己的同类。[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]本游戏中的宗教[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]我们知道人们对宗教怀有极其强烈的看法——事实上，许多战争正是在这些信仰相撞时爆发的。我们 Firaxis 无意冒犯任何人。然而，鉴于宗教在人类发展中的重要性，我们不愿干脆将它们完全排除在游戏之外；相反，我们尽力以尽可能尊重、公平、一视同仁的方式来处理它们。事实上，游戏中所有宗教的效果都相同，唯一的区别在于它们的要求。[PARAGRAPH:2]文明 IV 中有七种宗教（测试确定七种是最利于游戏性的数量）。在确定纳入哪七种时，我们挑选了我们认为对玩家最为熟悉的那些宗教。我们无意暗示这些宗教比其他任何宗教更重要、更好或更差。[PARAGRAPH:2]我们不对宗教作任何价值评判；我们无意冒犯任何人的信仰。我们是游戏设计师，不是神学家。[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]创立宗教[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]若你是第一个发现相关科技的文明，该宗教便会在你的某座城市中创立。拥有一座创立了宗教的城市极为有用；它允许先知在该城市建立“圣坛”（见下文）。[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]国教[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]当你文明中的任何城市拥有一种或多种宗教时，你可以选择将其中一种指定为“国”教。拥有国教往往会使你信奉该宗教的城市更幸福、更高产；它还会增强许多宗教建筑与宗教政策的效果。[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]传播宗教[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]宗教在城市之间随机传播。宗教往往会从拥有该宗教的城市向邻近城市，以及向该城市有贸易路线相连的城市传播。一些宗教建筑（见下文）会加快宗教传播的速度，而一个文明的宗教政策（见下文）同样能对宗教传播产生很大影响。传教士让你能够掌控宗教的传播；见下一节。[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]传教士[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]文明可以建造特殊的“传教士”单位来传播本文明的国教。每个文明在任一时刻只能拥有有限数量的传教士单位，每个每回合花费两金维护。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]建造传教士[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2] 采用有组织宗教政策的文明可以在任何信奉国教的城市中建造传教士；若文明未采用有组织宗教，则只能在拥有修道院的城市中建造传教士。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]移动传教士[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]一经建成，传教士便可像其他单位一样在地图上移动。你的传教士可以自由进入你的领土或中立领土；在你与某文明签订开放边境协议之前，它们无法进入该文明的领土。 [PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]传教士如何传播宗教[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]当传教士位于目标城市时，点击传教士单位框中的“传播宗教”命令（见单位）；若尝试成功，传教士的宗教便进入了目标城市。宗教更容易传入传教士所属文明内的其他城市。此外，向已有宗教很少或没有宗教的城市传播宗教更为容易；每有一种既存宗教都会降低成功几率。单座城市中可存在的宗教数量没有上限；全部七种宗教都能在同一座城市共存。无论成功与否，传教士都会在转化尝试中被消耗。[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]宗教的益处[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]城市益处[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]所有拥有你国教的城市都会额外获得一张笑脸，并每回合产出一点文化。因此，在你文明的早期阶段，传播国教是扩展文化边境的好办法。你国教的圣城还额外获得每回合五点文化加成，使其边境迅速扩张。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]建筑[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]若城市中没有宗教，该城市便无法建造神殿、大教堂等宗教建筑（见下文）。没有宗教的城市也无法创造祭司专家。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]圣坛收入[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]若你控制着某种宗教的圣城并诞生了一位大先知，你便可以为该宗教建造圣坛，为世界上每一座拥有你宗教的城市带来收入（见下文）。[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]宗教政策[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]宗教政策描述了宗教如何影响你的文明。游戏中有五种宗教政策。开局时你只知晓异教信仰；当你学会相关科技后，另外四种便会解锁。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]异教信仰：[\\BOLD] 无科技要求。基本的宗教政策。 [PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]有组织宗教：[\\BOLD] 需要一神论。提升信奉国教城市的建筑生产，并允许你无需先建造修道院即可建造传教士。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]神权政治：[\\BOLD] 需要神学。神权政治为信奉国教城市内训练的单位额外授予两点经验，并阻止非国教宗教在文明内的传播。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]和平主义：[\\BOLD] 需要哲学。大幅提升信奉国教城市中的伟人诞生率，并增加军事单位的维护费用。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]信仰自由：[\\BOLD] 需要自由主义。采用信仰自由的文明没有国教。每座城市中每有一种非国教宗教便获得幸福；此外，所有城市获得 10%% 的科研加成。[PARAGRAPH:2][H2]宗教建筑[\\H2][PARAGRAPH:2]有若干种宗教建筑可供建造。宗教建筑专属于特定宗教，只能在拥有该宗教的城市中建造。拥有多种宗教的城市可以为每种宗教建造宗教建筑：例如，一座同时拥有犹太教与儒教的城市，可以既建造犹太神殿又建造儒教神殿。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]神殿[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]最原始的宗教建筑。神殿提升城市的文化与幸福。它们允许将 1 点人口转化为祭司专家。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]修道院[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]修道院少量提升城市的科研。更重要的是，它们允许城市建造传教士来传播你的宗教。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]大教堂[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]大教堂大幅提升城市的文化。若其宗教是文明的国教，则还提升幸福。它们允许将两点人口转化为祭司。请注意，“大教堂”是对某种宗教更宏伟礼拜场所的统称——犹太会堂、伊斯兰清真寺、基督教大教堂等等，效果都相同。你的文明每拥有三座神殿才能建造一座大教堂；例如，拥有七座神殿的文明可以建造两座大教堂。 [PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]圣坛[\\BOLD][PARAGRAPH:2]圣坛只能在创立了某种宗教的城市中建造。圣坛由大先知建造；大先知是唯一能建造圣坛的单位，且先知会在此过程中被消耗。圣坛加快宗教的传播，也提升所在城市的文化。它们提升城市诞生先知的几率，并允许城市指派三点人口作为祭司。最重要的是，圣坛为地图上每一座拥有该圣坛宗教的城市每回合产生一金（这也说明了建造传教士以传播教义的重要性）。每种宗教都有其大教堂与圣坛的不同名称。

chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 士兵们团结在他们的剑之英雄周围。

english: Soldiers from our victorious %s3_unit have rallied behind their combat heroes! Their strength and resolve have firmed! Their proficiency has increased!
chinese: 我们凯旋的 %s3_unit 中的士兵团结在他们的战斗英雄周围！他们的力量与决心更加坚定！他们的战斗本领增长了！

english: Decorate our glorious heroes of the sword!
chinese: 为我们光荣的剑之英雄授勋！

english: Heroes of the Sword
chinese: 剑之英雄

english: While hunting, our %s3_unit has discovered a rich supply of a black oil that burns rather hot.
chinese: 我们的 %s3_unit 在狩猎时发现了大量燃烧起来颇为炽热的黑色油脂。

english: We have no time for such nonsense. Order them to continue scouting.
chinese: 我们没时间理会这种无稽之谈。命令他们继续侦察。

english: This substance must be studied to see how we might make use of it.
chinese: 必须研究这种物质，看看我们能如何加以利用。

english: Inspired %s3_religion_adjective missionaries from the %s1_civ_adjective city of %s2_city have greatly expanded the influence of their religion!
chinese: 来自 %s1_civ_adjective 城市 %s2_city 的受感召的 %s3_religion_adjective 传教士大大扩展了他们宗教的影响力！

english: Inspired %s4_religion_adjective missionaries have spread their influence out of %s2_city. They now seek an audience with you, requesting your assistance in funding additional missions to the %s1_civ_adjective Empire.
chinese: 受感召的 %s4_religion_adjective 传教士已将他们的影响力传播出 %s2_city。他们如今寻求觐见你，恳请你资助向 %s1_civ_adjective 帝国派遣更多的传教行动。

english: We are unable to assist at this time.
chinese: 我们此刻无力相助。

english: We can afford a small donation.
chinese: 我们负担得起一笔小额捐助。

english: We are pleased to provide any assistance they may require!
chinese: 我们乐意提供他们所需的一切援助！

english: Inspired by religious music and sculpture in %s2_city, a new Great Artist has emerged in the %s1_civ_adjective Empire.
chinese: 受 %s2_city 的宗教音乐与雕塑所激发，%s1_civ_adjective 帝国涌现出了一位新的大艺术家。

english: The music played in your %s5_building in %s2_city has inspired a young person, who has grown into a Great Artist!
chinese: %s2_city 你的 %s5_building 中演奏的音乐激励了一位年轻人，他成长为了一位大艺术家！

english: The art and sculpture decorating the %s5_building in %s2_city has nurtured the imagination and talents of a new Great Artist!
chinese: 装点 %s2_city %s5_building 的艺术与雕塑，滋养了一位新的大艺术家的想象力与才华！

english: Please grant an audience to this promising new artist so that we may decide how best to make use of their talents.
chinese: 请召见这位前途无量的新艺术家，以便我们决定如何最好地发挥他的才华。

english: A fire has destroyed the Forge in the %s1_civ_adjective city of %s2_city.
chinese: 一场火灾摧毁了 %s1_civ_adjective 城市 %s2_city 的锻造场。

english: A careless apprentice started a fire at the Forge in %s2_city, during which the facility was destroyed.
chinese: 一名粗心的学徒在 %s2_city 的锻造场引发火灾，锻造场在火中被毁。

english: Brush fires sparked by dry conditions near %s2_city spread to the trade district. The Forge was burned down.
chinese: 干燥天气在 %s2_city 附近引燃的野火蔓延至商业区。锻造场被烧毁。

english: Unknown arsonists have torched the Forge in %s2_city.
chinese: 身份不明的纵火犯烧毁了 %s2_city 的锻造场。

english: Organize a rebuilding effort.
chinese: 组织一次重建行动。

english: Investigate the cause of the fire.
chinese: 调查起火原因。

english: We are too pressed to spare any attention to a small fire.
chinese: 我们自顾不暇，无力分心去管一场小火。

english: A dreadful harvest for our %s1_civ_adjective neighbors in the city of %s6_city just across the border has left its people starving. We may have a chance to gain favor with them if we provide humanitarian assistance from %s2_city.
chinese: 我们边境彼侧的 %s1_civ_adjective 邻邦城市 %s6_city 收成惨淡，令其民众忍饥挨饿。若我们从 %s2_city 提供人道援助，或许有机会博得他们的好感。

english: Famine has struck the city of %s6_city. Our people in %s2_city have enough food on hand to assist their %s1_civ_adjective neighbors. We stand ready to provide aid and comfort.
chinese: 饥荒袭击了 %s6_city。我们 %s2_city 的民众手头有足够的食物援助他们的 %s1_civ_adjective 邻邦。我们随时准备提供援助与慰藉。

english: Tragedy has struck just beyond your border, as the %s1_civ_adjective Empire struggles to feed all its hungry people in %s6_city. Many will die without enough to eat. Should the citizens of %s2_city move to assist them?
chinese: 就在你的边境之外发生了不幸，%s1_civ_adjective 帝国正竭力供养 %s6_city 中所有饥饿的民众。许多人将因缺粮而死。%s2_city 的市民是否应当出手相助？

english: We are unable to assist at this time. Send our condolensces to their leaders.
chinese: 我们此刻无力相助。向他们的领袖致以哀悼。

english: Open the city granaries and send half the stores to our troubled neighbors.
chinese: 打开城市粮仓，把半数存粮送给我们陷入困境的邻邦。

english: Send all of the food stores! Spare no expense to aid our friends!
chinese: 把所有存粮都送去！不惜一切代价援助我们的朋友！

english: The generous people of %s2_city have donated famine relief to the endangered people of %s4_city. This humanitarian effort has brought the two nations closer together.
chinese: %s2_city 慷慨的民众向身处险境的 %s4_city 民众捐赠了饥荒救济。这次人道努力拉近了两国的关系。

english: The generous people of %s2_city have donated massive famine relief to the starving people of %s4_city. This generous humanitarian effort has brought the two nations much closer together.
chinese: %s2_city 慷慨的民众向饥肠辘辘的 %s4_city 民众捐赠了大量饥荒救济。这次慷慨的人道努力大大拉近了两国的关系。

english: The %s1_civ_adjective people in %s2_city have sent half their stored food to your city of %s4_city to fend off starvation caused by a poor local harvest. This humanitarian relief may represent a positive turning point in your relations.
chinese: %s2_city 的 %s1_civ_adjective 民众把半数存粮送到了你的城市 %s4_city，以抵御当地歉收造成的饥荒。这次人道救济或许标志着你们关系的积极转折。

english: The generous %s1_civ_adjective people in %s2_city have sent all of their food stores to your city of %s4_city to prevent famine caused by a poor local harvest. This humanitarian effort has brought your two peoples much closer together!
chinese: %s2_city 慷慨的 %s1_civ_adjective 民众把所有存粮都送到了你的城市 %s4_city，以防止当地歉收造成的饥荒。这次人道努力大大拉近了你们两族人民的关系！

english: A slave revolt has taken place in the %s1_civ_adjective city of %s2_city!
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 城市 %s2_city 发生了奴隶暴动！

english: A slave revolt has taken place in %s2_city!
chinese: %s2_city 发生了奴隶暴动！

english: The slaves in %s2_city have rebelled against their keepers. The city is in chaos.
chinese: %s2_city 的奴隶反抗他们的看管者。城市陷入混乱。

english: Production at %s2_city has been halted temporarily by rebellious slaves.
chinese: %s2_city 的生产被暴动的奴隶暂时中断。

english: The slaves in %s2_city are still in revolt. Local authorities are bumbling the crackdown.
chinese: %s2_city 的奴隶仍在暴动。当地当局的镇压一片混乱。

english: The local authorities in %s2_city have so far been unable to put down the slave revolt.
chinese: %s2_city 的当地当局至今未能平息奴隶暴动。

english: The slave revolt in %s2_city continues unabated. The economy there is at a standstill.
chinese: %s2_city 的奴隶暴动仍未平息。那里的经济陷入停滞。

english: Crack down on the rebels. Put down the revolt. Re-establish order.
chinese: 严厉镇压叛乱者。平息暴动。重建秩序。

english: Restore order first, then investigate and redress some of the slaves' grievances.
chinese: 先恢复秩序，然后调查并纠正奴隶们的一些不满。

english: We are too busy to be bothered. Leave the matter to the local authorities. (Revolt may continue)
chinese: 我们太忙，无暇他顾。此事交给当地当局处理。（暴动可能持续）

english: Our spiritual leaders are urging us to seek the blessings of the sea![PARAGRAPH:1]The wise masters have divined the way regarding our relationship with the sea. They urge us to embrace the sea, to broaden our influence over it and spread our traditions to new lands.
chinese: 我们的宗教领袖敦促我们去寻求大海的祝福！[PARAGRAPH:1]智慧的大师们已就我们与大海的关系占卜出了方向。他们敦促我们拥抱大海，扩大我们对它的影响，并将我们的传统传播到新的土地。

english: The Blessed Sea[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your religious leaders to found cities on new landmasses. If you can build enough cities on new landmasses you will please the masters, who will offer you a choice of rewards.
chinese: 受祝福之海[PARAGRAPH:1]你的宗教领袖交给你在新陆块上建立城市的任务。若你能在新陆块上建造足够多的城市，便会取悦大师们，他们将为你提供一份奖励供你选择。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must establish or capture cities on %d1 total landmasses of any size, from one-plot islands to massive continents. All landmasses where you have at least one city are counted. Note that additional cities on the same island or continent do not help in this quest. The goal is to establish your presence on a number of different landmasses and thereby prove your mastery over the waters.[PARAGRAPH:1] You will fail this quest if you change state religions, cease to have a state religion or reach [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Industrialism[COLOR_REVERT] without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须在总共 %d1 块陆块上建立或占领城市，无论其大小，从一格小岛到广袤大陆皆可。凡是你至少拥有一座城市的陆块都会被计入。请注意，同一座岛屿或大陆上的额外城市对此任务无益。目标是在若干不同的陆块上建立你的存在，以此证明你对海洋的掌控。[PARAGRAPH:1] 若你更换国教、失去国教，或在未满足条件的情况下抵达[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]工业主义[COLOR_REVERT]，你将任务失败。

english: %s4_religion_adjective leaders have bestowed grand rewards upon the %s1_civ_adjective people for completing the Quest of the Blessed Sea!
chinese: %s4_religion_adjective 领袖们因 %s1_civ_adjective 民众完成受祝福之海任务而赐予他们丰厚的奖赏！

english: Congratulations! You have met the goals of your religious masters and spread your civilization across the waters. You have completed the quest of The Blessed Sea.
chinese: 恭喜！你已达成宗教大师们的目标，将你的文明传遍了海洋。你已完成受祝福之海任务。

english: Establish your religion in a number of your cities.
chinese: 在你的若干城市中确立你的宗教。

english: Receive a Temple improvement in all cities with five population or more, where your State Religion is present.
chinese: 在所有人口达到五及以上、且存在你国教的城市中获得一座神殿设施。

english: Receive a Great Prophet.
chinese: 获得一位大先知。

english: You have failed the quest of The Blessed Sea.
chinese: 你未能完成受祝福之海任务。

english: A %s4_civ_adjective passenger aircraft has crashed within %s1_civ_adjective territory. Neither side has provided any details of the incident.
chinese: 一架 %s4_civ_adjective 客机在 %s1_civ_adjective 领土内坠毁。双方均未透露该事件的任何细节。

english: A %s1_civ_adjective passenger flight has crashed in our territory near %s2_city.
chinese: 一架 %s1_civ_adjective 客机在我们 %s2_city 附近的领土内坠毁。

english: Allow their recovery teams unfettered access to the crash site.
chinese: 允许他们的救援队不受限制地进入坠机现场。

english: Stall them for time while your own team learns what it can first.
chinese: 拖延他们，好让我们自己的团队先摸清情况。

english: Deny access. Claim the wreckage and let your engineers pore over it.
chinese: 拒绝进入。宣称残骸归我方所有，让我们的工程师仔细研究。

english: One of your passenger airliners has crashed in %s1_civ_adjective territory. They have allowed unrestricted access to your recovery teams, building trust between your two nations.
chinese: 你的一架客机在 %s1_civ_adjective 领土内坠毁。他们允许你的救援队不受限制地进入，增进了你们两国之间的信任。

english: One of your passenger airliners has crashed in %s1_civ_adjective territory. They seemed to be unsure how to react at first, but finally allowed your recovery teams access to the crash site.
chinese: 你的一架客机在 %s1_civ_adjective 领土内坠毁。他们起初似乎不知如何应对，但最终还是允许你的救援队进入坠机现场。

english: One of your passenger airliners has crashed in %s1_civ_adjective territory. They are denying all access and have claimed the wreckage as their own. This outrage has angered your people and driven a diplomatic wedge between your two nations.
chinese: 你的一架客机在 %s1_civ_adjective 领土内坠毁。他们拒绝一切进入，并宣称残骸归其所有。这一暴行激怒了你的民众，在你们两国之间打入了一根外交楔子。

english: Bandits are wreaking havoc in %s1_civ_adjective farmlands.
chinese: 盗匪正在 %s1_civ_adjective 农田中肆虐。

english: Farmers outside %s2_city are complaining of bandits robbing them regularly.
chinese: %s2_city 外的农夫抱怨盗匪时常抢劫他们。

english: Criminal activity has disrupted food production in a farming region outside %s2_city.
chinese: 犯罪活动扰乱了 %s2_city 外一处农业区的食物生产。

english: We may need to take action against thieves in %s2_city who are preying upon our farmers.
chinese: 我们或许需要对 %s2_city 那些劫掠我们农夫的盗贼采取行动。

english: We need that food. Do whatever it takes to deal with those bandits.
chinese: 我们需要那些食物。不惜一切代价对付那些盗匪。

english: Dispatch some of our troops to hunt down these bandits.
chinese: 派出我们的一些部队去追捕这些盗匪。

english: We are too busy to be bothered. Leave the matter to the local authorities. (Banditry may continue)
chinese: 我们太忙，无暇他顾。此事交给当地当局处理。（盗匪活动可能持续）

english: The %s1_civ_adjective Empire continues to suffer a loss of food production due to banditry.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 帝国因盗匪活动持续遭受食物生产的损失。

english: The local authorities of %s2_city are still struggling to control the bandit activity plaguing our farmers.
chinese: %s2_city 的当地当局仍在竭力控制困扰我们农夫的盗匪活动。

english: Criminals are still preying on our farmers. A more stringent response may be necessary in %s2_city.
chinese: 罪犯仍在劫掠我们的农夫。%s2_city 或许需要更严厉的回应。

english: Our religious leaders believe our people can earn the blessings of the deity if we can reclaim the Holy Mountain![PARAGRAPH:1]They have studied the scriptures with an eye toward locating the holy mountain. They have so far not found it anywhere within our lands and believe that it must lie elsewhere. More study will be needed if we are to identify the sacred location.
chinese: 我们的宗教领袖相信，若我们能夺回圣山，我们的民众便能赢得神明的祝福！[PARAGRAPH:1]他们钻研经文，着意寻找圣山的位置。他们至今尚未在我们的土地上找到它，相信它必定位于别处。若要确定这处圣地，还需进一步钻研。

english: The Holy Mountain[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your religious leaders to locate, settle near and seize control over the Holy Mountain.
chinese: 圣山[PARAGRAPH:1]你的宗教领袖交给你寻找圣山、在其附近定居并夺取其控制权的任务。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must extend your cultural influence and control over the Peak plot that is the Holy Mountain. You may achieve this by divine providence by settling near any Peaks you find. Eventually you may find the right one.[PARAGRAPH:1]Or you may seek further guidance from studying the holy scriptures. If you build %d3 religious buildings (Temples and Monasteries), your religious leaders will solve the puzzle and identify the correct location of the Holy Mountain, which you must then still go and settle near to complete the quest. A %s2_building allows for more coordinated worship and is worth as much as four Temples for the purposes of this quest.[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if you change state religions, cease to have a state religion, or reach [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Industrialism[COLOR_REVERT] without having met the conditions. You will also fail this quest if any other civilization takes control of the Holy Mountain before you do.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须将你的文化影响与控制扩展至作为圣山的那格山峰。你可以凭借天意，在你找到的任何山峰附近定居来达成这一点。最终你或许能找到正确的那座。[PARAGRAPH:1]或者你也可以通过钻研圣典寻求进一步的指引。若你建造 %d3 座宗教建筑（神殿与修道院），你的宗教领袖便会解开谜题并指明圣山的正确位置，之后你仍须前往该处附近定居方能完成任务。一座 %s2_building 能实现更为协调的礼拜，就此任务而言相当于四座神殿。[PARAGRAPH:1]若你更换国教、失去国教，或在未满足条件的情况下抵达[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]工业主义[COLOR_REVERT]，你将任务失败。若在你之前有任何其他文明夺取了圣山的控制权，你同样会任务失败。

english: You have failed the quest of The Holy Mountain.
chinese: 你未能完成圣山任务。

english: The faithful %s3_religion_adjective people are inspired by the divine providence of the %s1_civ_adjective Empire for completing the Quest of the Holy Mountain!
chinese: 虔诚的 %s3_religion_adjective 民众为 %s1_civ_adjective 帝国完成圣山任务所彰显的天意而深受鼓舞！

english: Your people are inspired by the way in which you have honored your faith.
chinese: 你尊崇信仰的方式激励了你的民众。

english: Look at the Holy Mountain.
chinese: 查看圣山。

english: Congratulations! You have located the Holy Mountain and extended your cultural influence over the sacred site!
chinese: 恭喜！你已找到圣山，并将你的文化影响扩展至这处圣地！

english: You have built enough religious buildings for your religious leaders to solve the puzzle and identify the correct location of the Holy Mountain. Settle near that location to complete the quest!
chinese: 你已建造足够多的宗教建筑，让你的宗教领袖得以解开谜题、指明圣山的正确位置。前往该处附近定居即可完成任务！

english: %s1_civ_adjective horticulturists have harnessed rare local resources to produce remedies.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 园艺师利用当地稀有资源制成了药剂。

english: Herbalists have discovered rare and precious plants that grow in abundance only in a certain region near %s2_city.
chinese: 草药师发现了一些珍稀名贵的植物，它们只在 %s2_city 附近的某个地区大量生长。

english: A medicinal tea cultivated by locals has been found to be effective with treating illnesses. This tea grows only in a specific region near %s2_city.
chinese: 当地人培育的一种药茶被发现能有效治疗疾病。这种茶只生长在 %s2_city 附近的某个特定地区。

english: Certain rare insects found near %s2_city, when harvested and ground into a paste by a reclusive tribe, can be ingested to reduce fever.
chinese: %s2_city 附近发现的某种稀有昆虫，由一个离群索居的部落采集并研磨成糊后，可服用以退烧。

english: We should establish internal trade with the locals for these rare commodities.
chinese: 我们应就这些稀有商品与当地人建立内部贸易。

english: Fund efforts to increase production without endangering the natural resources that produce them.
chinese: 资助在不危及其原料天然资源的前提下增产的努力。

english: %s1_civ_adjective investments in horticulture have paid off! A new minor industry is thriving in %s2_city, boosting health and research.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 在园艺上的投入得到了回报！一项新的小型产业在 %s2_city 蓬勃发展，提升了健康与科研。

english: %s1_civ_adjective authorities are rumored to have captured a fugitive fleeing from %s4_civ_adjective justice. No confirmation is available.
chinese: 据传 %s1_civ_adjective 当局抓获了一名逃避 %s4_civ_adjective 法律制裁的逃犯。此消息尚无法证实。

english: A fugitive from justice, wanted for crimes in the %s1_civ_adjective Empire, has been discovered hiding out in our territory.
chinese: 一名在 %s1_civ_adjective 帝国因罪被通缉的逃犯，被发现藏匿在我们的领土内。

english: An assassin wanted for slaying a %s1_civ_adjective official has been caught fleeing through our land.
chinese: 一名因杀害 %s1_civ_adjective 官员而被通缉的刺客，在穿越我们领土逃亡时被抓获。

english: Extradite the offender back to his homeland.

chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 掷弹兵单位已配发更有效的爆炸物：无需引信的炸弹。

english: A master smith has devised a firing pin for our grenades, ending the need to use fuses.
chinese: 一位铁匠大师为我们的手榴弹设计出了击针，从此无需再用引信。

english: Supply our Grenadiers with the improved explosives.
chinese: 为我们的掷弹兵配备改良的爆炸物。

english: %s1_civ_adjective Cannon units can now shoot farther and more accurately thanks to improved barrel design.
chinese: 得益于改良的炮管设计，%s1_civ_adjective 加农炮单位如今能打得更远、更准。

english: Our knowledge of rifled barrels has been successfully applied to new cannon designs.
chinese: 我们对膛线炮管的知识已成功应用于新的加农炮设计。

english: Do we want stronger cannon? Is that a trick question?
chinese: 我们想要更强的加农炮吗？这还用问？

english: The %s1_civ_adjective Empire has halted production of aircraft carriers with wooden decks. Their decks are now made of steel.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 帝国已停止建造木质甲板的航空母舰。他们的甲板如今改用钢铁。

english: Our shipmasters have concluded that switching to steel decks on our carriers instead of wooden decks would be to our advantage.
chinese: 我们的船匠断定，把我们航母的木质甲板改为钢质甲板将对我们有利。

english: Make it so.
chinese: 照办。

english: The %s1_civ_adjective Empire has developed a long range Fighter plane.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 帝国研发出了一款远程战斗机。

english: Our engineers have developed an advanced fighter design that is lighter and carries slightly more fuel, extending its operational range.
chinese: 我们的工程师研发出了一种先进的战斗机设计，它更轻便、载油略多，从而延长了作战航程。

english: Begin production of the new fighter.
chinese: 开始生产这款新战斗机。

english: %s1_civ_adjective Pikemen have begun using a new type of halberd, boosting their strength versus foot soldiers.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 长枪兵开始使用一种新型戟，提升了他们对步兵的战力。

english: Our weapon masters have devised a halberd design that remains fully effective versus mounted units but will boost effectiveness versus foot soldiers.
chinese: 我们的武器大师设计出了一种戟，它对骑乘单位仍完全有效，同时能提升对步兵的效能。

english: Issue the new weapons to all of our pikemen.
chinese: 为我们所有的长枪兵配发新武器。

english: Rumors abound that %s1_civ_adjective shipmasters are doing extensive refitting work on their trireme fleet.
chinese: 流言四起，称 %s1_civ_adjective 船匠正在对他们的三列桨座战船舰队进行大规模改装。

english: Our shipmasters have devised a way to reinforce the hulls of our triremes. This will help with both ramming and being rammed.
chinese: 我们的船匠想出了一种加固三列桨座战船船体的方法。这对撞击敌船和被敌船撞击都有帮助。

english: Our existing ships can also be refitted? Begin immediately.
chinese: 我们现有的船只也能改装？立即着手。

english: Fire has destroyed the Theatre in %s2_city.
chinese: 一场火灾摧毁了 %s2_city 的剧院。

english: A careless cigarette smoker started a fire at the Theatre in %s2_city, during which the building was destroyed and numerous patrons died.
chinese: 一名粗心的烟民在 %s2_city 的剧院引发火灾，剧院在火中被毁，众多观众丧生。

english: An accident on stage at the Theatre in %s2_city started a fire that burned down the building. Most of the audience escaped alive, thank goodness.
chinese: %s2_city 剧院的一场舞台事故引发了大火，把建筑烧成了灰烬。谢天谢地，大部分观众逃生。

english: Organize a rebuilding effort.
chinese: 组织一次重建行动。

english: Investigate the cause of the fire.
chinese: 调查起火原因。

english: We are too pressed to spare any attention to a fire.
chinese: 我们自顾不暇，无力分心去管一场火灾。

english: %s1_civ_adjective forces have unexpectedly shown mercy and compassion for our wounded, tending them on the battlefield and then returning the survivors safely to us.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 军队出人意料地对我们的伤员展现了仁慈与同情，在战场上救护他们，随后又将幸存者安全送还给我们。

english: No good deed shall go unpunished. Send our recovered soldiers back into battle the moment they are ready.
chinese: 善举也当受罚。我们康复的士兵一准备就绪，就立刻送回战场。

english: Perhaps this is a sign that enough blood has been shed. Send our emissaries to see if they are ready to discuss peace.
chinese: 或许这是个信号，流的血已经够多了。派我们的使者去看看他们是否愿意商谈和平。

english: A heroic gesture of mercy by your forces in regard to %s1_civ_adjective wounded has opened the door to a possible peace treaty. Do you wish to end the war?
chinese: 你的军队对 %s1_civ_adjective 伤员的一次英勇仁慈之举，为一份可能的和平条约打开了大门。你希望结束这场战争吗？

english: A heroic gesture of mercy by the %s3_civ_adjective forces toward the %s1_civ_adjective wounded has brought an unexpected opportunity for peace. The two sides are at least pausing to consider the possibility.
chinese: %s3_civ_adjective 军队对 %s1_civ_adjective 伤员的一次英勇仁慈之举，带来了意想不到的和平契机。双方至少停下来考虑这种可能了。

english: A great mediator has emerged, offering to arbitrate the dispute between %s1_civ_adjective leadership and our nation. This could be a chance for peace.
chinese: 一位伟大的调停者出现了，提出仲裁 %s1_civ_adjective 领导层与我们国家之间的争端。这或许是一个和平的机会。

english: We do not want peace! Let the war continue.
chinese: 我们不要和平！让战争继续。

english: Peace would benefit both sides. Give our blessing to this mediator, and may his words prove sharper than their hatreds.
chinese: 和平将惠及双方。给予这位调停者我们的祝福，愿他的言辞比他们的仇恨更为锋利。

english: A great mediator has offered to arbitrate our grievance with the %s1_civ_adjective Empire. This opens the door to a possible peace treaty. Do you wish to end the war?
chinese: 一位伟大的调停者提出仲裁我们与 %s1_civ_adjective 帝国的争端。这为一份可能的和平条约打开了大门。你希望结束这场战争吗？

english: A great mediator has attempted to broker peace between the %s1_civ_adjective and %s3_adjective Empires!
chinese: 一位伟大的调停者试图在 %s1_civ_adjective 与 %s3_adjective 帝国之间斡旋和平！

english: The legend of Forty Thieves is luring treasure hunters and adventure seekers to %s2_civ_adjective lands.
chinese: 四十大盗的传说正把寻宝者与探险者引向 %s2_civ_adjective 的土地。

english: The legend of Forty Thieves has attracted treasure hunters and tourists to the area, boosting local commerce.
chinese: 四十大盗的传说吸引了寻宝者与游客来到该地区，提振了当地商业。

english: Excellent.
chinese: 好极了。

english: In the sands of a %s2_civ_adjective desert, archaeologists have unearthed a cache of ancient texts.
chinese: 在 %s2_civ_adjective 沙漠的黄沙中，考古学家发掘出了一批古代文献。

english: Archaeologists have unearthed a cache of scrolls and stone tablets buried in the desert sands.
chinese: 考古学家发掘出了一批埋藏在沙漠黄沙中的卷轴与石板。

english: Disperse the texts to various researchers and specialists, to see what we might learn.
chinese: 把这些文献分发给各路研究者与专家，看看我们能有何发现。

english: Fund an effort to preserve these artifacts in museums, accessible only to the most careful scholars.
chinese: 资助一项努力，将这些文物保存于博物馆中，只对最谨慎的学者开放。

english: The Waters of Life, drawn from a certain oasis in %s2_civ_adjective lands, are rumored to be able to cure the sick and heal the injured.
chinese: 据传，取自 %s2_civ_adjective 土地上某处绿洲的生命之水，能够治愈病人、疗愈伤者。

english: Folklore claims that the Waters of Life may be drawn from a certain oasis. Rumors are spreading that these waters can heal the sick and injured.
chinese: 民间传说称，生命之水可从某处绿洲取得。流言四起，称这些水能治愈病人与伤者。

english: This will attract more traffic to the oasis? That sounds good.
chinese: 这会为绿洲吸引更多往来人流？听起来不错。

english: Discovery of naturally occurring glass globules has been ignored by %s1_civ_adjective leadership and will pass in to the dustbin of history.
chinese: 天然生成的玻璃球粒的发现被 %s1_civ_adjective 领导层忽视，终将湮没于历史的尘埃之中。

english: %s1_civ_adjective geologists have discovered a rich source of [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Uranium[COLOR_REVERT] at what turned out to be a very large and ancient impact crater.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 地质学家在一处后来证实是极为古老的巨型撞击坑处，发现了丰富的[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]铀[COLOR_REVERT]来源。

english: Researchers have discovered a large incidence of naturally formed glass globules in an area around a wide circular valley.
chinese: 研究者在一片宽阔的环形谷地周围地区，发现了大量天然形成的玻璃球粒。

english: Why is this important? Do not bother me with petty details.
chinese: 这有什么重要的？别拿这些琐事来烦我。

english: Commit our government to unlocking the secrets of this mystery.
chinese: 命我们的政府去揭开这个谜团的秘密。

english: We are likely to take the worst of the barbarian horde's fury.
chinese: 我们很可能要承受蛮族大军最猛烈的怒火。

english: A massive barbarian uprising is occurring. Attila the Hun leads his forces in a crusade against the very concept of civilization.
chinese: 一场大规模蛮族起义正在发生。匈王阿提拉率领他的军队，向文明这一概念本身发起了讨伐。

english: [ICON_BULLET]A dangerous number of barbarian [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Horse Archer[COLOR_REVERT] units have spawned near our border.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]数量危险的蛮族[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]弓骑兵[COLOR_REVERT]单位已在我们边境附近诞生。

english: A massive barbarian uprising is occurring. The Vandals strike out against civilization, seeking to claim its prizes with their swords.
chinese: 一场大规模蛮族起义正在发生。汪达尔人向文明发起进击，妄图以他们的刀剑夺取文明的战利品。

english: [ICON_BULLET]A dangerous number of barbarian [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Swordsman[COLOR_REVERT] units have spawned near our border.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]数量危险的蛮族[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]剑士[COLOR_REVERT]单位已在我们边境附近诞生。

english: A massive barbarian uprising is occurring. The Goths have gathered an army and their axemen seek to plunder civilizations.
chinese: 一场大规模蛮族起义正在发生。哥特人已集结起一支军队，他们的斧兵企图劫掠各文明。

english: [ICON_BULLET]A dangerous number of barbarian [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Axeman[COLOR_REVERT] units have spawned near our border.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]数量危险的蛮族[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]斧兵[COLOR_REVERT]单位已在我们边境附近诞生。

english: A massive barbarian uprising is occurring. The Philistines have gathered an army of spearmen and are on the march.
chinese: 一场大规模蛮族起义正在发生。非利士人已集结起一支长矛兵大军，正在进军途中。

english: [ICON_BULLET]A dangerous number of barbarian [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Spearman[COLOR_REVERT] units have spawned near our border.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]数量危险的蛮族[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]矛兵[COLOR_REVERT]单位已在我们边境附近诞生。

english: A massive barbarian uprising is occurring. The Vedic Aryans seek to plunder the riches of civilization.
chinese: 一场大规模蛮族起义正在发生。吠陀雅利安人企图劫掠文明的财富。

english: [ICON_BULLET]A dangerous number of barbarian [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Archer[COLOR_REVERT] units have spawned near our border.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]数量危险的蛮族[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]弓手[COLOR_REVERT]单位已在我们边境附近诞生。

english: %s1_civ_adjective sales of incense are booming.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的熏香销量正在激增。

english: The high priest of the temple in %s2_city has placed a large order for our domestically produced incense for use in holy rituals.
chinese: %s2_city 神殿的大祭司下了一笔大订单，采购我们本国生产的熏香用于圣典。

english: Fill the order!
chinese: 供应这笔订单！

english: The well-protected %s1_civ_adjective citizens endure paying a Security Tax to help maintain their city walls and guards.
chinese: 受到良好保护的 %s1_civ_adjective 市民，忍受着缴纳一笔治安税以帮助维持他们的城墙与守卫。

english: Our citizenry, fully protected by city walls, have accepted the burden of a Security Tax to help maintain their protection.
chinese: 我们的市民在城墙的充分保护下，已接受了缴纳一笔治安税以帮助维持他们的防护这一负担。

english: Collect the taxes!
chinese: 征收这笔税款！

english: The learned %s1_civ_adjective people enjoy a virtually universal literacy rate.
chinese: 博学的 %s1_civ_adjective 民众享有近乎全民普及的识字率。

english: Our citizenry enjoys virtually universal literacy. This achievement is bound to pay off in unexpected ways.
chinese: 我们的市民享有近乎全民普及的识字率。这一成就必将以意想不到的方式带来回报。

english: Continue to promote reading and writing. Knowledge is power!
chinese: 继续推广读写。知识就是力量！

english: The taxes from these sales should nicely boost our coffers.
chinese: 这些销售的税收应能大大充实我们的国库。

english: %s1_civ_adjective plow sales are booming.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的犁具销量正在激增。

english: A new plow design has become popular. Our Forges have filled orders for the new plows from farmers across our lands.
chinese: 一种新的犁具设计变得流行起来。我们的锻造场已供应了来自全国各地农夫的新犁订单。

english: %s1_civ_adjective stained glass sales are booming.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的彩色玻璃销量正在激增。

english: A large order of stained glass has been shipped to %s2_city.
chinese: 一大批彩色玻璃已运往 %s2_city。

english: %s1_civ_adjective officials in %s2_city have lavishly decorated their public buildings with finely carved marble statues.
chinese: %s2_city 的 %s1_civ_adjective 官员用精雕细刻的大理石雕像奢华地装点了他们的公共建筑。

english: Local officials in %s2_city have ordered a large number of marble statues to adorn their public buildings and their forum.
chinese: %s2_city 的当地官员订购了大量大理石雕像，以装点他们的公共建筑与广场。

english: %s1_civ_adjective crab cake sales are booming.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的蟹肉饼销量正在激增。

english: Crab cakes prepared in our cities have become enormously popular across the region.
chinese: 我们城市中烹制的蟹肉饼已在整个地区大受欢迎。

english: %s1_civ_adjective factories are benefitting from a new boiler design, providing a short term rise in their tax revenue.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的工厂正受益于一种新式锅炉设计，其税收得以短期上升。

english: A new design of steel boiler is in demand, because it can raise manufacturing productivity.
chinese: 一种新设计的钢制锅炉需求旺盛，因为它能提升制造业的生产力。

english: %s1_civ_adjective personal computers, manufactured in %s2_city, are selling in record numbers.
chinese: %s2_city 制造的 %s1_civ_adjective 个人电脑正以创纪录的数量热销。

english: Personal computers manufactured in %s2_city are in high demand among homes and small businesses.
chinese: %s2_city 制造的个人电脑在家庭与小企业中需求旺盛。

english: The %s1_civ_adjective mass transit system in %s2_city has begun to use advanced fuel additives to reduce pollution, cut costs, and improve vehicle performance.
chinese: %s2_city 的 %s1_civ_adjective 公共交通系统开始使用先进的燃料添加剂，以减少污染、削减成本并改善车辆性能。

english: The mass transit system in %s2_city has implemented a city-wide program of using fuel additives to reduce pollution and improve on maintenance costs and fuel efficiency.
chinese: %s2_city 的公共交通系统推行了一项全市范围的燃料添加剂使用计划，以减少污染并改善维护成本与燃油效率。

english: Reduced costs, lower pollution and improved revenues are always welcome news.
chinese: 成本降低、污染减少、收入提升，永远都是好消息。

english: %s1_civ_adjective entrepreneurs have invented the fast food hamburger joint. Thanks to radio advertising, this phenomenon is spreading rapidly.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 企业家发明了快餐汉堡店。得益于电台广告，这一现象正迅速蔓延。

english: A new type of rapid-service restaurant selling primarily hamburgers was launched recently. Thanks to successful radio advertising, the chain is now expanding across the nation.
chinese: 一种主要出售汉堡的新型快餐店近来问世。得益于成功的电台广告，这家连锁店如今正向全国扩张。

english: Can we have fries with that? Thanks!
chinese: 能来份薯条吗？谢啦！

english: %s1_civ_adjective citizens who are socially advanced have adopted imported %s4_civ_adjective tea as their beverage of choice.
chinese: 社会地位显赫的 %s1_civ_adjective 市民已将进口的 %s4_civ_adjective 茶叶奉为他们的首选饮品。

english: Imported %s1_civ_adjective tea has become all the rage amongst our social elite.
chinese: 进口的 %s1_civ_adjective 茶叶已在我们的社会精英中风靡一时。

english: The taxes from these sales should boost our coffers nicely, as well as boosting our relations.
chinese: 这些销售的税收应能大大充实我们的国库，同时提升我们的关系。

english: Tea exports to %s1_civ_adjective customers have provided a nice boost to our relations.
chinese: 向 %s1_civ_adjective 客户出口茶叶，为我们的关系带来了不错的提升。

english: Silk dresses manufactured in %s1_civ_adjective factories have become an extremely popular fashion choice across the region, due in part to radio advertising.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 工厂制造的丝绸礼服，部分得益于电台广告，已在整个地区成为极受欢迎的时尚之选。

english: Silk dresses have become the latest fashion, sweeping the nation thanks to radio advertising.
chinese: 丝绸礼服已成为最新时尚，得益于电台广告席卷全国。

english: Thoroughbred race horses raised by %s1_civ_adjective breeders have generated extra revenue for their treasury.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 育马者培育的纯种赛马，为他们的国库带来了额外收入。

english: A new breed of race horse is generating a lot of revenue from our stables.
chinese: 一个新品种的赛马正为我们的马场带来大量收入。

english: %s1_civ_adjective diamond ring sales are booming.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的钻戒销量正在激增。

english: Jewelers have successfully launched a tradition of the diamond ring as the gift of choice for wedding proposals.
chinese: 珠宝商成功开创了以钻戒作为求婚首选礼物的传统。

english: Invention of the banana split by a %s1_civ_adjective businessman has led to booming ice cream sales for their vendors.
chinese: 一位 %s1_civ_adjective 商人发明的香蕉船，令他们的商贩冰淇淋销量激增。

english: One of our ice cream parlors has invented the banana split.
chinese: 我们的一家冰淇淋店发明了香蕉船。

english: Mmm, ice cream. The customers must be going bananas over that!
chinese: 嗯，冰淇淋。顾客们准是为它疯狂着迷了！

chinese: 我们的驯马师相信，与我们的坐骑建立更深的默契与理解是可能的。[PARAGRAPH:1]他们需要一个更庞大、更协调的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]马厩[COLOR_REVERT]网络来追求这一目标。

english: Horse Whispering[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your elite trainers to build enough stables for them to transcend the traditional limits of animal husbandry.
chinese: 驭马术[PARAGRAPH:1]你的精英驯马师交给你建造足够多马厩的任务，好让他们超越畜牧的传统极限。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must build %d1 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Stables[COLOR_REVERT] in your various cities.[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first, or if you reach the Renaissance Era without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须在你的各座城市中建造 %d1 座[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]马厩[COLOR_REVERT]。[PARAGRAPH:1]若有敌对文明先你一步完成，或你在未满足条件的情况下抵达文艺复兴时代，你将任务失败。

english: You have failed the quest of Horse Whispering
chinese: 你未能完成驭马术任务

english: %s1_civ_adjective stable masters and horse trainers have completed the quest of Horse Whispering!
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的马厩主与驯马师完成了驭马术任务！

english: Congratulations! You have met the goals of your horse trainers and built for them enough facilities to empower their plans. Please choose a reward from among the benefits your horse trainers are able to provide to you.
chinese: 恭喜！你已达成驯马师们的目标，为他们建造了足够多的设施以助其实现计划。请从你的驯马师能为你提供的益处中选择一份奖励。

english: Use our advantage to immediately train [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Horse Archers[COLOR_REVERT].
chinese: 利用我们的优势立即训练[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]弓骑兵[COLOR_REVERT]。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Receive %d1 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Horse Archers[COLOR_REVERT].
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]获得 %d1 个[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]弓骑兵[COLOR_REVERT]。

english: Our horses are trained to be more productive on the farm.
chinese: 我们的马匹经过训练，在农场上更为高产。

english: Use our existing horses as more effective scouts.
chinese: 让我们现有的马匹充当更有效的斥候。

english: Our harbormasters request government aid in expanding our overseas trading empire.[PARAGRAPH:1]We will need to build enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Harbors[COLOR_REVERT] in our cities and construct enough ocean worthy ships.
chinese: 我们的港务长请求政府援助，以扩展我们的海外贸易帝国。[PARAGRAPH:1]我们需要在城市中建造足够多的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]港口[COLOR_REVERT]，并建造足够多的适航远洋的船只。

english: The Harbormaster[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your merchant marine industry to build enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Harbors[COLOR_REVERT] for them to become the undisputed trading kings of the sea. You will also need to build a fleet of [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Caravels[COLOR_REVERT] to help carry cargo across deep water.
chinese: 港务长[PARAGRAPH:1]你的商船业交给你建造足够多[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]港口[COLOR_REVERT]的任务，好让他们成为无可争议的海上贸易之王。你还需要建造一支[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]卡拉维尔帆船[COLOR_REVERT]舰队，以帮助跨越深水运送货物。

english: The seaworthy %s1_civ_adjective people have completed the quest of The Harbormaster!
chinese: 适航远洋的 %s1_civ_adjective 民众完成了港务长任务！
